blocks.text: The Philippine theater scene is set for a major showcase as the inaugural Teatro Panalo received 373 original one-act play submissions. From the 373 entries, 26 one-act plays have advanced to the festival’s shortlist, with 16 straight plays and 10 musicals making the cut.
